new_scholarship.name: Convocatoria de Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026 (National Postgraduate Scholarships 2026)
new_scholarship.official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (SECIHTI) - Dirección General de Becas y Apoyos a la Comunidad Científica y Humanista
new_scholarship.description: The Mexican Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (SECIHTI, the body that succeeded CONAHCyT) invites Mexican and foreign nationals to apply for 2026 postgraduate scholarships. Applicants must already be enrolled in a postgraduate programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) that is eligible for scholarship allocation. The call is open and closes 28 November 2026 at 23:59 Mexico City time. The scholarship pays a monthly economic support set by the 2026 national scholarship tariff plus medical cover through ISSSTE registration; the official call page does not state tuition coverage.
new_scholarship.duration: Full length of the registered postgraduate programme, in complete months, without exceeding the maximum term set in the scholarship regulation
new_scholarship.application_period: Published 23 February 2026; applications accepted 23 February 2026 20:00 to 28 November 2026 23:59 (America/Mexico_City)
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Mexican or foreign nationals enrolled in a full-time (escolarizado) postgraduate programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados and eligible for scholarship allocation, who still hold a previous SECIHTI/CONAHCyT scholarship must first complete the conclusion formalities of that award.
eligibility: Mexican nationality, or foreign nationals resident in Mexico
Enrolled in a full-time (escolarizado) postgraduate programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) and eligible for scholarship allocation
Prior SECIHTI/CONAHCyT scholarship holders must have completed the conclusion formalities of the previous award before registering a new application
Must hold a valid Clave Única de Registro de Población (CURP); foreign nationals use the CURP on their temporary resident card and must keep it valid
Must satisfy all requirements at the time of the ordinary application period, or apply during the inconsistencies period if the call provides one
coverage: Monthly economic support (apoyo económico mensual) set by the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026
Medical service through ISSSTE (Instituto de Seguridad y Servicios Sociales de los Trabajadores del Estado), registered as a beneficiary (derechohabiente)
benefits: Formalisation and bank-account registration support through the official guides published with the call
requirements: Create, update or validate the CVU (currículum vitae) in the Perfil Único at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/
Register and submit the scholarship application following the Guía para la postulación de Becas Nacionales
Sign the application electronically with the CURP e-signature
Pay the registration and formalisation guides' procedural steps in the Apeiron system after an award is assigned
Register a bank account (Guía para el Registro de Cuenta Bancaria BNP)
required_documents: CURP (Mexican citizens) or the CURP contained in the temporary resident card (foreign nationals)
CVU generated in the Perfil Único
Evidence of registration in the postgraduate programme (the SNP registry record)
Prior CONAHCyT/SECIHTI completion or non-debt letter where applicable (Carta de Reconocimiento o Carta de No Adeudo)
application_method: Register the CVU in the Perfil Único / Rizoma portal
Submit the scholarship request electronically with CURP e-signature during the published window
After an award is assigned, complete formalisation, sign the electronic documents and register the bank account in Apeiron
new_scholarship.english_requirement: Spanish. The call, the guides and the Rizoma/Apeiron systems are published in Spanish only.
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is carried out by SECIHTI over two periods of applicant eligibility; proposals are evaluated against the eligibility rules published in the call and its Términos de Referencia.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Mexican citizens, or foreign nationals legally resident in Mexico, already enrolled (or about to be enrolled) in a SNP-registered postgraduate programme who need a monthly stipend to complete a master's or doctorate.
new_scholarship.notes: Applicants enrolled in non-schooled (no escolarizados) eligible programmes are covered by the parallel Términos de Referencia B and the separate postulation guides linked from the same official page. Selection is made in two periods, with eligibility windows covering studies starting between January and June 2026 and between August and November 2026.

programme_detail_official.application_cycle: 2026 postgraduate scholarship call; applications open 23 February 2026 and close 28 November 2026
programme_detail_official.deadline_central_display: sábado, 28 noviembre 2026 - 11:59 PM hora local CDMX
programme_detail_official.deadline_note: The official call page states 'Estatus de la convocatoria: Abierta' with 'Conclusión de recepción de solicitudes: sábado, 28 noviembre 2026 - 11:59 PM hora local CDMX'. The published day 'sábado' matches 28 November 2026.
programme_detail_official.status_note: Call published 23 February 2026 and still shown as open on the official page when read on 2026-10-04.
programme_detail_official.funding_duration: Monthly instalments for the complete months of the registered programme, capped by the maximum term in the scholarship regulation
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: The official page and its linked terms of reference describe a monthly economic support and ISSSTE medical service; no tuition payment is stated.
programme_detail_official.funding_label: Monthly scholarship instalment (amount set by the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026) plus ISSSTE medical cover; no tuition coverage stated
benefits: Apoyo económico mensual per the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026
Access to the SECIHTI formalisation and bank-account registration guides
eligibility: Personas de nacionalidad mexicana o extranjera inscritas en programas registrados en el Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) para la asignación de becas
Program must be an eligible full-time (escolarizado) postgraduate programme
Previous CONAHCyT/SECIHTI award holders must have completed the conclusion formalities first
Electronic signature with CURP; foreigners use the CURP on their temporary resident card
programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: Mexican nationals, or foreign nationals residing in Mexico
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Foreign nationals are eligible but must hold valid temporary resident status in Mexico; the official text states that SECIHTI does not intervene in the immigration situation of the applicant or their economic dependants.
programme_detail_official.study_mode: Full-time, in-person (escolarizado) programme registered in the SNP; a separate set of terms of reference covers non-schooled programmes
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrolment in a postgraduate programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados; the call does not restrict the field of study
programme_detail_official.application_method: Online registration in the Perfil Único (Rizoma), then electronic submission of the scholarship request signed with CURP; formalisation, electronic signature of the agreement and bank-account registration follow in Apeiron once an award is assigned.
programme_detail_official.application_route: SECIHTI Perfil Único / Rizoma portal, then the Apeiron scholarship formalisation system
requirements: Create, update or validate the CVU in the Perfil Único at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/
Register and send the scholarship application per the Guía para la postulación de Becas Nacionales
Sign the application electronically with the CURP
If requirements are not complete in the ordinary period, apply in the inconsistencies period shown in the call calendar
Register a bank account using the official BNP account-registration guide
documents: Official identification with photograph, in force
CURP, or the CURP on the temporary resident card for foreign nationals
SNP registration evidence for the postgraduate programme
Carta de Reconocimiento o Carta de No Adeudo where a previous CONAHCyT/SECIHTI award existed
programme_detail_official.english_requirement_note: The call is published in Spanish only; the application is completed in Spanish through the Rizoma/Apeiron systems, and electronic signature is via CURP, so Spanish-language administrative capability is required.
selection_criteria: Compliance with the eligibility rules of the call and its Términos de Referencia
Registration of the programme in the SNP and its eligibility for scholarship allocation
Completion of previous award formalities where applicable
programme_detail_official.duration: Vigencia de la beca established in complete months by homologation of processes, according to the duration of the programme registered in the SNP and without exceeding the maximum term in the scholarship regulation
award_holder_conditions: The scholarship is tied to the SNP-registered programme and to the formalised agreement; changes require SECIHTI authorisation
Applicants must complete the conclusion (trámite de conclusión) formalities at the end of the award
Foreign applicants must keep valid temporary resident status; SECIHTI does not intervene in immigration matters
supplements_or_initiatives: ISSSTE medical service obtained through beneficiary registration
Separate guides for postulation, formalisation, bank-account registration and visa/resident-card support

programme_detail_official.description: SECIHTI's 2026 National Postgraduate Scholarship call funds Mexican and foreign nationals enrolled in eligible postgraduate programmes registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados. The award provides a monthly economic support set by the 2026 tariff plus ISSSTE medical service. Applications run from 23 February 2026 to 28 November 2026 and are submitted through the Perfil Único/Rizoma and Apeiron systems.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Monthly stipend plus ISSSTE health cover; tuition and travel are not covered

application_readiness_checklist: CVU created or validated in the Perfil Único at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/ before the application window opens
Programme confirmed as registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados and flagged as eligible for scholarship allocation
CURP in hand (foreign nationals: the CURP printed on the temporary resident card, still valid)
Any earlier CONAHCyT/SECIHTI award closed with the trámite de Conclusion already completed
Electronic signature (e.firma) working, since the request must be signed with the CURP
Scanned official identification with photograph ready to upload
common_rejection_risks: The postgraduate programme is not registered in the SNP, or is registered but not flagged as eligible for scholarship allocation
A previous CONAHCyT/SECIHTI scholarship was left open, so the conclusion formalities were never completed
The CURP is missing, expired, or the temporary resident card is no longer valid for a foreign applicant
The request was not signed electronically with the CURP before the 28 November 2026 23:59 cut-off
Applying through the wrong terms of reference: non-schooled (no escolarizados) programmes have a separate set of guides and rules
estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees, where the host programme charges them, since the call states only a monthly economic support
Cost of books, materials, laboratory or fieldwork costs
Living costs in excess of the monthly scholarship instalment, which is set by tariff and not by programme
Flights, visa fees and relocation costs for international applicants
Thesis printing, publication and defence costs
document_audit: Official identification in force and legible
CURP matching the name exactly as registered in the Perfil Único
CVU PDF generated on or before the submission date
Evidence of SNP registration naming the exact programme and its duration in months
Carta de Reconocimiento or Carta de No Adeudo for every prior CONAHCyT/SECIHTI award
Bank account documentation in the holder's own name, ready for the registration step

alerts.message: The window is unusually long but closes at 23:59 Mexico City time on a Friday; do not leave the electronic signature to the last day.
Beneficiaries are selected in two periods keyed to study start dates, so registering late can push an application into a later evaluation round.
An award is not final until it shows as 'Asignada' in Apeiron and the agreement is signed there; the monthly payment depends on that.

alerts.trigger: Foreign applicants hold no immigration protection
alerts.message: SECIHTI states explicitly that it does not intervene in the applicant's immigration situation, so temporary resident status must be maintained independently.

submission_workflow: Create or validate the CVU in the Perfil Único at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/
Check the programme appears in the SNP as eligible for scholarship allocation
Complete the online scholarship request following the Guía para la postulación
Sign the request electronically with the CURP and submit before 28 November 2026 23:59 CDMX
Monitor the application status; if a requirement is missing, use the inconsistencies period shown in the call calendar
If assigned, sign the agreement, annexes and ISSSTE letter in Apeiron and register the bank account

research_notes.logo: null. The SECIHTI page is a WordPress site whose visible header logo is inlined as a base64 data URI (a 100x100 transparent SVG placeholder) rather than served as a file, so there is no HTTP-fetchable image asset to probe there. The two official wp-content PDF documents linked from the call are not image assets. No official image file was found on secihti.mx during this research, and no third-party asset was substituted.
unverified: Monthly stipend amount in MXN (Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026 not opened)
Selection weighting (Términos de Referencia PDFs not opened)
Two selection-period study start-date ranges (seen only in a search snippet of a PDF, not fetched)
research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: Official call text: 'A personas de nacionalidad mexicana o extranjera inscritas en programas registrados en el Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) para la asignación de becas, para que soliciten una Beca de Posgrado'. The title of the call is 'Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026' and the linked terms of reference are headed 'Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado en programas elegibles escolarizados', confirming postgraduate (master's and doctoral) study rather than undergraduate.
research_notes.dedup_check: Checked against the shard's dedup lists before researching: no entry for SECIHTI, secihti.mx, CONAHCyT or any Mexican postgraduate scholarship in existing_titles, existing_hosts or existing_official_source_urls. The 20 existing titles are all Canadian (provincial and federal) awards and the 15 existing hosts are all Canadian domains, so there is no overlap.

rejected.candidate: Quebec Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE)
Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship
Society of Women Engineers (SWE) Collegiate/Graduate Scholars Scholarship
rejected.reason: no current cycle and no published next-window date; swe.org states 'Now CLOSED for the 26-27 Academic Year' and only offers an interest form for 2027-2028 with no opening date. Information sessions are 'typically in January' but no date is published, which fails the 'published application window' test.

rejected.candidate: Society of Hispanic Engineers (SHPE) ScholarSHPE Scholarships
rejected.reason: the official page still describes the February 2026 window that has already closed ('Application opens: February 2, 2026 / Application closes: February 16, 2026') and publishes no 2027 dates, so no current or announced cycle exists on the awarding body's own page.

rejected.candidate: H. Allen Brooks Travelling Fellowship (Society of Architectural Historians)
rejected.reason: 2027 cycle closed 31 August 2026 and the next application period does not open until 1 July 2027, which is outside the ~10-month window allowed by the brief.
2027 cycle closed and the official page states applications for the 2028 fellowship open in July 2027, outside the permitted window.

rejected.candidate: National Press Foundation annual journalism awards
rejected.reason: deadline was 30 September 2026, four days before the research date, and these are recognition awards for already-published work rather than a funding award for study.

rejected.candidate: American Musicological Society graduate fellowships (Alvin H. Johnson AMS 50, Holmes/D'Accone, Howard Mayer Brown)
rejected.reason: the official fellowships page publishes no application deadline or opening date for any of the three fellowships; only 'Fellows are selected in the spring and announced in the summer'. Fails the 'published application window' test.

rejected.candidate: Canadian Journalism Foundation Indigenous Health Journalism Fellowship
rejected.reason: official page states 'Applications for 2026 are now closed' and no 2027 opening date or window is published by the foundation; the annual call is only announced through a newswire, which is not the awarding body's own page.

rejected.candidate: AIBS Emerging Public Policy Leadership Award
rejected.reason: official page says only 'Please check back this winter for additional information on the 2027 award' with no application window, deadline or criteria for 2027.
the 2026 nomination period closed on 28 January 2026 and both partners say to check back later for the 2027 cycle; no published 2027 window.

rejected.candidate: National Sport School merit scholarships / Canadian Sport School scholarships and bursaries
rejected.reason: not a national scholarship programme: the National Sport School states its merit scholarships are 'typically offered near the end of the program' and are not entrance scholarships, so there is no application window an applicant can use.

rejected.candidate: RAIC Foundation Scholarships, Bursaries and Awards (Canada Green Building Council, Kiyoshi Matsuzaki, Arts and Letters Club of Toronto, Vince Catalli)
rejected.reason: 2026 cycle closed on the published dates (CaGBC 8 March 2026, Matsuzaki 29 March 2026) and the RAIC does not publish a 2027 call on these pages; the news item announcing the cycle is dated November 2025, so no current or announced window exists.

rejected.candidate: AIA Medal for Academic Excellence and other AIA awards
rejected.reason: honours and medals with no funding attached, so they are not funding awards under the brief.
